title: Sora-sora anu satia di gigireun Nabi
intro: Di hiji nagri anu jauh, saurang utusan anu mulya nyanghareupan panolakan anu keras ti kakawasaan anu ngawasa jaman harita. Tapi aya sakumpulan leutik jiwa-jiwa anu satia nangtung di gigireun hamba Allah ieu, sumanget pisan pikeun ngajawab panggero ilahi. Kayakinan anu teu goyah bakal ngabagi hiji bangsa anu kuat sareng pamustunganana bakal unggul ngalawan kakuatan kafir.
clues: Kami mangrupikeun kelompok alit anu satia, ngahiji dina iman sareng tujuan.
Kami nangtung di gigireun utusan mulya anu ditolak ku pamaréntah anu kuat di nagri maranéhanana.
Nalika utusan ieu naros, 'Saha pendukung kuring di jalan Allah?' kami ngawaler tanpa ragu.
Kami nyuhunkeun utusan ieu pikeun milarian pésta ti langit pikeun mawa katengtreman kana haté kami.
Di antara jalma-jalma dina jaman harita, aya anu percaya kana risalah kami sareng anu sanésna nolak, tapi Allah nguatkeun jalma-jalma anu ariman.
Urang téh kaum Hawariyyun — murid-murid Isa anu satia, anu meunang ku ayana dukungan Allah.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
